description: TypeScript patterns and pitfalls for monorepo development

patterns.title: Workspace package naming convention
patterns.problem: Need consistent naming for internal packages

patterns.title: Shared TypeScript config extension
patterns.solution: Create packages/config/tsconfig.base.json and extend it in each package

patterns.title: Bun workspace catalog for version management
patterns.problem: Keeping dependency versions in sync across packages
patterns.solution: Use workspaces.catalog in root package.json, reference with "catalog:" in packages

patterns.title: Branded types with Zod for ID safety
patterns.problem: Structurally identical IDs (FeatureId, ProjectId) can be accidentally swapped
patterns.solution: Use Zod .brand<>() to create nominal types that prevent mixing at compile time

patterns.title: Status enum pattern with const + Zod
patterns.problem: Need both TypeScript type safety and runtime validation for status values
patterns.solution: Define as const object, derive type, create z.enum() schema

patterns.title: Regex pattern validation with branded types
patterns.problem: Need to validate string IDs match specific patterns (F001, CAT-XXX) at runtime
patterns.solution: Chain .regex() before .brand() for pattern-validated branded types
patterns.codeAfter:
const FeatureIdSchema = z
  .string()
  .regex(/^F[0-9]{3}$/, 'Feature ID must be F001-F999')
  .brand<'FeatureId'>();

patterns.title: Zod default() does not need optional()
patterns.solution: Use .default() alone - it already handles undefined input

patterns.title: Nested schema defaults with transform
patterns.problem: Using .default({}) on nested schema doesn't propagate inner field defaults when parent is undefined
patterns.solution: Use .optional().transform() to explicitly merge with defaults

patterns.title: TanStack Router beforeLoad auth guard
patterns.problem: Need to protect routes from unauthenticated access
patterns.solution: Use beforeLoad hook to check auth and redirect to login

patterns.title: TanStack Router type-safe params
patterns.problem: Route params need type safety without manual type annotations
patterns.solution: Use Route.useParams() which returns typed params based on route path

patterns.title: Zustand StateCreator with generics
patterns.problem: Combining multiple slices with proper type inference
patterns.solution: Use StateCreator<AppStore, [], [], SliceType> for each slice

patterns.title: Zustand getState() for event handlers
patterns.problem: Calling store actions from event handlers causes unnecessary re-renders
patterns.solution: Use useAppStore.getState().action() instead of selector hook for one-off calls

patterns.title: TanStack Query cache invalidation on mutation
patterns.problem: UI shows stale data after mutations
patterns.solution: Use queryClient.invalidateQueries() in mutation onSuccess callback

patterns.title: TanStack Router Link activeProps
patterns.problem: Need to style nav links based on current route
patterns.solution: Use activeProps on Link component - TanStack Router auto-applies when route matches

patterns.title: Test environment setup with bunfig.toml preload
patterns.problem: Server tests importing env module trigger Zod validation at import time before test env is set
patterns.solution: Use bunfig.toml [test] preload to execute test-setup.ts before all test imports
patterns.codeBefore: // Test fails: Zod validation error for missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
patterns.gotcha: If env vars are not set before imports, Zod validation fails at module load time, causing all tests to fail with cryptic errors about missing env vars

pitfalls.title: TanStack Router routeTree.gen.ts not found
pitfalls.error: Cannot find module './routeTree.gen' or its corresponding type declarations
pitfalls.cause: Route tree file is auto-generated on first build/dev run
pitfalls.prevention: Run 'vite build' or 'vite dev' once before 'tsc --noEmit'

pitfalls.title: Vite import.meta.env type casting
pitfalls.cause: Vite's import.meta.env needs type assertion for @t3-oss/env-core
pitfalls.prevention: Use (import.meta as any).env or add proper Vite client types

pitfalls.title: Package scope mismatch during rebase
pitfalls.cause: When main branch renames packages (e.g., @F001/* to @nomos-ai/*), worktree code references old names
pitfalls.prevention: After rebase, check for package name references in tsconfig.json extends and package.json dependencies

bestPractices.title: Schema composition via imports
bestPractices.description: Compose schemas by importing existing ID schemas rather than duplicating definitions
bestPractices.pattern: import { ExistingIdSchema } from './ids'; // Then use in new schemas

bestPractices.title: oRPC queryOptions for type-safe data fetching
bestPractices.description: Use orpc.{entity}.{method}.queryOptions() for full type inference with TanStack Query

bestPractices.title: Curried Zustand selectors for memoization
bestPractices.description: Create curried selectors to enable memoization at selector creation time
bestPractices.pattern: export const selectProjectById = (id: string) => (state: AppStore) => state.projects.find(p => p.id === id);
